Rashi on Sotah 10b:11:1.hebrew: מנא ידע - שממנו היא מעוברת, שמא אף אחרים באו עליה:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:11:1.english: How did he know - that she was pregnant by him, [seeing that] perhaps others, too, had relations with her?

Rashi on Sotah 10b:11:2.english: And he said - A heavenly voice said [it].

Rashi on Sotah 10b:11:3.hebrew: כבושים - דברים עלומים שנגזרו מלפני שיצאו מזו מלכים, ואי אפשר לצאת אלא מיהודה, דכתיב (בראשית מ״ט:ט׳) "גור אריה יהודה". כבושים — דברי סתר, גזירת המלך. כמו "בהדי כבשי דקודשא בריך הוא למה לך" בברכות (דף י.) גבי חזקיה:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:11:3.english: Hidden things (kevushim) - Concealed matters that were decreed before kings came forth from this one [Tamar], and [kings] could come forth only from Judah, as it is written (Genesis 49:9): "Judah is a lion's whelp." *Kevushim* means secret matters, the King's decree. This is like [the expression] "Why do you need to meddle with the hidden things (*kivshei*) of the Holy One, Blessed be He?" in Berakhot (10a), regarding Hezekiah.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:12:1.hebrew: כיון שידעה - שידע בה שהיא צדקת, ולשם שמים נתכוונה:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:12:1.english: Once he knew her - That he knew about her that she was righteous, and that she had intended [her act] for the sake of Heaven.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:13:1.hebrew: מקץ ימים לימים - משנה לשנה, שנזיר עולם היה ומגלח אחת לי"ב חודש:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:13:1.english: At the end of days, [after] days - From one year to the next, for he was a lifelong nazirite and would cut his hair once every twelve months.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:15:1.hebrew: דקריב רישיה לגבי גופיה - שהיה ראשו מושלך רחוק מגופו, וקירבו:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:15:1.english: That he brought his head close to his body - For his head had been thrown far from his body, and he brought it near.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:16:1.english: That he took a bad purchase for himself - And this is what the verse is saying: "And Absalom took for himself this pillar during his lifetime, and set up for himself the pillar which is in the King's Valley."

Rashi on Sotah 10b:16:2.hebrew: עצה עמוקה - של הקב"ה, שהוא מלך עולם, שגזר על דוד כן במעשה בת שבע:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:16:2.english: A deep counsel - Of the Holy One, blessed be He, who is King of the world, who decreed this upon David in the matter of Bathsheba.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:1:1.hebrew: אלא ויקריא - למד לבריות לקרות שם בשם ה' אל עולם:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:1:1.english: Rather, "and he called" - He taught people to call upon the name of the Lord, God of the world.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:1:2.hebrew: כיצד - לאחר שאכלו ושתו משלו, היו עומדין לברכו לאברהם, והוא אומר להם: וכי משלי אכלתם?:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:1:2.english: How so? - After they ate and drank of his own [food], they would stand up to bless Abraham, and he would say to them: Did you then eat of mine?

Rashi on Sotah 10b:3:1.hebrew: שכסתה פניה בבית חמיה - ולא ראה אותה כל הימים שגדלה בביתו, לפיכך לא הכיר בה:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:3:1.english: That she covered her face in her father-in-law's house - And he did not see her all the days that she was growing up in his house; therefore he did not recognize her.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:3:2.hebrew: אמוץ - אביו של ישעיהו. ואמציה מלך יהודה אחים הוו, ואמציה מזרע דוד היה, ואמוץ אחיו נביא היה. אלמא, נביאים נפיק מינה:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:3:2.english: Amoz - The father of Isaiah. And Amaziah, king of Judah, [and Amoz] were brothers; and Amaziah was of the seed of David, and his brother Amoz was a prophet. Evidently, prophets came forth from [the line of Judah and David].

Rashi on Sotah 10b:4:1.hebrew: היא מיתוצאת - הוי משמע לשון הוצאה בעל כרחה. "היא מוצאת" משמע לשון מציאה:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:4:1.english: "She is brought out" [hi mitotzet] - This would imply an expression of being taken out against her will. "She finds" [hi motzet] implies an expression of finding.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:4:2.hebrew: סימניה - חותמו ופתילים ומטה. שבא סמאל, שהוא שר של אדום, וריחקן, כדי שתשרף ולא יצא דוד ממנה, המכה את אדום בגיא מלח:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:4:2.english: Her signs - His seal, and cords, and staff. [This is] because Samael, who is the prince of Edom, came and distanced them, so that she would be burned and David would not descend from her — he who strikes Edom in the Valley of Salt.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:1.hebrew: יונת אלם רחוקים - על עסקי הרחקה שנעשו סימניה רחוקים:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:1.english: A silent dove among those far away - Concerning the matter of distancing, [for] her signs were made distant.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:2.english: Of David, a Michtam - Referring to her, who was destined and fit to have David descend from her:

Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:3.english: And Tam - Perfect in his ways.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:5.hebrew: מכתו תמה - מקום מילה, שהוא ראוי למכה, היה תם ושלם, שלא הוצרך לחסרו:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:5.english: His wound was whole - The place of the circumcision, which is the place fit for a wound, was whole and complete, so that it was not necessary to diminish it.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:6.english: Another explanation: Just as in his smallness - Before he became king.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:7.hebrew: כך בגדולתו - לאחר שמלך. ולשון מכתם — שהיתה תמה מכתו מתחלתו ועד סופו — לא נחסר ענוותנותו ולא נשתנית:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:5:7.english: So too in his greatness - After he became king. And the term "michtam" [means] that his "blow" (makato) was whole (tamah) from its beginning to its end: his humility was not diminished and did not change.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:6:1.hebrew: והיא שלחה וגו' לאיש אשר אלה לו - ולא שלחה לו לאמר: ״ממך אני הרה״, והרי סימנין שלך:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:6:1.english: And she sent, etc., to the man to whom these belong - And she did not send to him saying, "I am pregnant by you," even though the identifying signs are yours.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:6:2.hebrew: ותימא ליה מימר - לשליח אמור לו: שממנו אני הרה, ואלו סימניו:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:6:2.english: And let her say to him - [she should say] to the messenger: Say to him that I am pregnant from him, and these are his identifying signs.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:6:3.hebrew: ואל ילבין כו' - אף זו נוח היה לה לישרף, ואל תלבין פניו. לפיכך שלחה לו: אם יודה ויגלה הוא עצמו את הדבר — יגלה, ואם לאו — תשרף, ולא תגלה היא את הדבר:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:6:3.english: And let him not whiten, etc. - Even this one [Tamar] preferred to be burned rather than whiten his [Judah's] face [i.e., shame him]. Therefore she sent to him: If he will admit and reveal the matter himself, let him reveal it; and if not, let me be burned, and I will not reveal the matter myself.

Rashi on Sotah 10b:7:1.hebrew: בהכר בישר - אל אביו, דבר שנצטער בו, ובהכר בשרוהו:
Rashi on Sotah 10b:7:1.english: With "haker" he announced [the news] - to his father, a matter over which [the father] was distressed; and with "haker" they announced [the news] to him.

Tosafot on Sotah 10b:11:1.hebrew: יצאת בת קול ואמרה ממני יצאו כבושים - בשלהי מסכת מכות (דף כג:) מסיק דהכי גמירי לה:
Tosafot on Sotah 10b:11:1.english: A heavenly voice emerged and said, "From Me came the hidden things" - At the end of tractate Makkot (23b) [the Gemara] concludes that this is how they received it [as a tradition]:

Tosafot on Sotah 10b:15:1.hebrew: דקרב רישא לגבי גופיה - תימה: רבי מאיר דאמר בחלק (סנהדרין דף קג:): "אבשלום אין לו חלק לעולם הבא", א"כ סבירא ליה דקרב רישיה לגבי גופיה, ולא סבירא ליה דאייתיה לעלמא דאתי? מכל מקום אסקיה משבעה מדורי דגיהנם, ואם כן אמאי לא חשיב ליה בהדי אחז ואחזיה, דאמר (שם קג.): "לא חיין ולא נידונין"? וי"ל דלא חשיב אלא מלכים:
Tosafot on Sotah 10b:15:1.english: That the head drew close to the body - It is puzzling: Rabbi Meir, who said in [the chapter] Chelek (Sanhedrin 103b), "Absalom has no share in the World to Come" — so he holds that the head drew close to the body, yet he does not hold that [David] brought him to the World to Come? In any case, [David] raised him up from the seven compartments of Gehinnom. If so, why does [Rabbi Meir] not count him together with Ahaz and Ahaziah, of whom it says (ibid. 103a), "They neither live nor are judged"? And one can answer that he counts only kings.

Tosafot on Sotah 10b:15:2.hebrew: דאייתיה לעלמא דאתי - ואי קשיא, הא אמרו בחלק (סנהדרין דף קד.): ברא מזכי אבא, אבא לא מזכי ברא, כדכתיב: "ואין מידי מציל" — אין אברהם מציל את ישמעאל, ולא יצחק את עשו. אבל הבן מציל את האב, כגון יאשיהו, שלא מנו את אמון! וי"ל: משום דאבשלום נטל את שלו בעולם הזה, שנהרג במיתה משונה, הועילה לו תפלת אביו. דומיא דיהויקים, דאמר התם שהיה כתוב על גולגלתו "זאת ועוד אחרת", ונפרע ממנו לאחר מיתה — לא מנו אותו. ועוד, אבשלום לא עבד עבודת כוכבים. א"נ מצי למימר: הא דאמר "אבא לא מזכי ברא" — היינו משום כבוד האב; אין מונעין מלמנותו עם רשעים בלא תפלה, אבל תפלה מועלת, ודוד התפלל על אבשלום:
Tosafot on Sotah 10b:15:2.english: That he brought him to the World to Come - And if you object: Didn't they say in [chapter] Chelek (Sanhedrin 104a): A son can bring merit to a father, [but] a father cannot bring merit to a son, as it is written: "and there is none that can deliver" (Deuteronomy 32:39) — Abraham cannot deliver Ishmael, nor Isaac Esau. But a son can deliver a father, as in the case of Josiah, [through whom] they did not count Amon [among those who have no share in the World to Come]! And one can answer: Because Absalom received his [punishment] in this world, as he was killed by an unusual death, his father's prayer helped him. This is similar to Jehoiakim, about whom it says there that it was written on his skull, "This, and another yet to come," and he was punished after death — [yet] they did not count him [among those who have no share in the World to Come]. Furthermore, Absalom did not worship idols. Alternatively, one can say that what [the Gemara] said, "a father cannot bring merit to a son," is because of the honor owed to the father: [Heaven] does not refrain from counting him [the father] among the wicked without any prayer [on his behalf], but prayer is effective, and David prayed for Absalom:

Tosafot on Sotah 10b:6:1.hebrew: נוח לו לאדם שיפיל את עצמו לתוך כבשן האש - כדאמר בפ' הזהב (ב"מ דף נח:): כל היורדין לגיהנם עולין, חוץ משלשה, וחד מינייהו המלבין פני חבירו ברבים. ואומר נמי (שם נט.): נוח לו לאדם שיבעול ספק אשת איש, ואל ילבין פני חבירו ברבים. מנלן? מדוד. ונראה: האי דלא חשיב ליה (פסחים דף כה.) בהדי ג' עבירות שאין עומדים בפני פקוח נפש — עבודת כוכבים, וגילוי עריות, ושפיכות דמים — משום דעבירת הלבנת פנים אינה מפורשת בתורה, ולא נקט אלא עבירות המפורשות:
Tosafot on Sotah 10b:6:1.english: It is better for a person to throw himself into a fiery furnace - As it says in the chapter "HaZahav" (Bava Metzia 58b): All who descend to Gehenna ascend [again], except for three, and one of them is one who shames his fellow in public. And it also says (ibid. 59a): It is better for a person to have relations with a woman who is possibly married than to shame his fellow in public. From where do we derive this? From David. And it appears that the reason [the Gemara] does not count it (Pesachim 25a) together with the three transgressions for which one does not yield even in the face of danger to life — idolatry, forbidden relations, and bloodshed — is because the transgression of shaming is not explicitly stated in the Torah, and [the Gemara] mentioned only the transgressions that are explicitly stated:
